scope: Editorial research for /situations and /en/situations; use cases are proposed and illustrative. This is not a list of certified partnerships or deployed integrations.

software.name: Pennylane
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Company, Firm and FirmGroup APIs differ. Company API requires Essential or above; cabinet API scope and client authorisation must be checked. Mass integration/OAuth and FirmGroup access can require publisher approval.

software.name: Cegid Loop
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Publisher partner/cabinet APIs include documents, client files, accounting data and import status. API key, subscription key and Loop Hub configuration are required.

software.name: Sage Active
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Sage Active Public API V2 is GraphQL with OAuth 2.0 and API key. This is specifically Sage Active, not a claim about Sage 100 or all Sage products.

software.name: Kleos
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Wolters Kluwer confirms an API platform on the French product offer. API is an add-on on the displayed applicable plans; detailed endpoint access must be obtained from publisher. API availability alone does not prove access to every document or matter resource.

software.name: Clio Manage
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: OAuth application, user consent, resource scopes, user roles, regional endpoints and rate limits apply.

software.name: Microsoft 365
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Microsoft Graph covers Outlook, calendar, SharePoint, Teams and other services. Each chosen operation needs the corresponding permission; tenant admin approval can apply.

software.name: Salesforce
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: REST API documented. API access depends on the Salesforce edition, permissions and quotas; no customer account verified.

software.name: HubSpot
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: CRM objects API documented. Scopes, plan-specific features and publisher limits must be checked; the example does not claim a native VELOK connector.

software.name: Notion
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: REST API has connection/token permission boundaries and content must be made accessible to the selected connection.

software.name: Bullhorn
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: REST API supports entities and OAuth/session authentication. Customer API enablement and entity permissions must be checked. The limited public jobs API is not used as evidence of unrestricted CRM access.

software.name: Teamtailor
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Public API documents jobs, candidates and applications; keys, scopes, stack/region and customer permissions must be confirmed.

software.name: Brevo
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Public APIs cover contacts, campaigns, messages and events. Sending or publication still requires the workflow owner’s approval and applicable account capacity.

software.name: Lucca
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Versioned OAuth public API is recommended for new integrations but has incomplete resource coverage and some beta endpoints. Existing v3/v4 APIs remain documented; choose per endpoint.

software.name: Personio
software.verification: Publisher API documentation or official API offer inspected; no authenticated API call or deployed VELOK integration tested.
software.conditions: Public APIs and customer credentials are documented. Check enabled API access and per-resource readable/writable fields; no automatic candidate assessment proposed.
